cohort_rule: Named convenience cohort of real measurement tasks from PMLB, newly evaluated here. No test-score-based sampling or removal. One representation per original measurement collection. No general population sampling claim. Report source metadata and any unavailable/failed task.
outer: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3,shuffle=True,random_state=20261115); each row has one outer prediction per arm. PMLB tabular rows; no individual/group/time generalization.
inner: stratified 25% ranking from outer development, random_state=20421+fold; remainder for initial learner. Fit preprocessing using reference fit only for selection, and all outer development for final refit. Median impute, no label-dependent preprocessing, no preliminary width cap.
model: XGBClassifier CPU hist, 100 trees, depth 4, learning rate 0.1, n_jobs 1, random_state=20421+fold. All final refits use this same model and full outer development.
votes: Reuse archived compact Gain sizing, max 256 rows, strict 3/4 across four paired panels, 3% relative tolerances with 5% rare AP, training median, weakest-first block and singleton closure. Single-point arms generate and score only the point panel. For rare binary tasks encode the rarer development class as positive (class ID 1) deterministically from reference fit.
antichain: Theory module separating_contexts, empty and full endpoints plus binary equal-weight codes, tail columns assigned in rank order. Random control independently draws distinct uniform masks of each realized interior size, then adds the same endpoints, seed 77531+fold. Same anchor for all. For tail <=1 no interior masks.
l1: L1 logistic coefficient support, standardized reference-fit rows, C in [0.01,0.1,1,10], deterministic one-vs-rest liblinear on multiclass. Select C by macro OvR AUC of logistic predictions on ranking. Equal scores prefer fewer columns then smaller C. If zero coefficients select one maximum fit variance feature. Refit XGB on selected columns.
endpoints: Per-dataset mean outer fold macro OvR AUC, accuracy, retained count and fraction, selection+fit+final refit+predict elapsed seconds. Compare antichain vs nested min and random, nested vs optimized point, independent compact Gain, and matched Gain at nested Min k (donated width). Fold paired effects with dataset as inferential unit, no independent-fold test. Wall-clock cutoff 3600s per dataset/fold; log all failures. Machine/source versions recorded.
timing: Serial one-thread CPU in a persistent worker per fold. Shared reference fit and Gain anchor separately measured once per fold and added back for each arm that needs them; per-arm refit/predict measured independently. Includes imputer fit/transform, excludes acquisition, persistence and startup. Matched Gain excludes donor selection. Arm order cyclically rotated per fold and dataset; timing descriptive.
design_stage: Frozen before computing any learner scores on the named datasets; secondary to the earlier inspected six-dataset benchmark.
